hana: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we still see the three-repeat pattern: dropped trace headers -> missing spans; ETL replay windows -> inflated aggregates; and intermittent ETL lag after checkpoint GC. We need concrete owners, short timelines, and a minimal-impact backfill plan.
julian: I'll own trace/header propagation in edge and SDK. Plan: add header-enforce gate + CI roundtrip test. ETA: 48h. Canary: 24h at 10% traffic. Rollback: flip feature flag off. Blocker: confirm CDN passthrough.
park: I'll own the ETL checkpoint durability and sequence checks. Plan: write monotonic checkpoints to object store, add seq_id validation before applying batches. ETA: 72h.
monica: I'll handle the dedupe layer and the targeted backfill orchestration. Plan: lightweight dedupe worker (idempotency by request_id) + staging recompute for affected windows. ETA: 4 business days for worker + backfill runbook.
ops-bot: Postmortem doc published: https://confluence.redwood.example/pm/206123  reminders created for owners.
hana: Monica & Park please paste a short backfill SQL snippet and a one-line verification query for ops. Julian please paste the CI check bash one-liner.
park: backfill SQL (trimmed):
```sql
-- dedupe by request_id and latest event_ts
INSERT INTO rollups_staging (metric, window_start, value)
SELECT metric, window_start, SUM(value)
FROM (
  SELECT metric, window_start, value,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY request_id, metric, window_start ORDER BY event_ts DESC) rn
  FROM raw_events
  WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-28T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-28T06:00:00Z'
) t
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY metric, window_start;
```
monica: ops verification (short):
```sql
SELECT metric, SUM(value) as total FROM rollups_staging WHERE window_start BETWEEN '2026-03-28T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-28T06:00:00Z' GROUP BY metric ORDER BY metric;
```
julian: CI check (bash):
```bash
# assert X-Trace-ID propagated through edge -> service
curl -H "X-Trace-ID: trace-check-xyz" https://edge-test.redwood/health | grep trace-check-xyz || exit 1
```
hana: Ops needs the maintenance window; suggest dry-run on staging then live during 03:30-04:30 UTC low traffic slot. Monica can you estimate run time for a 4h window?
monica: Est run: 20-40m for the 4h window at current throughput. Dry-run ~15m. Need DB replica slot for swap and a snapshot point.
infra: IAM note: backfill job will need rollup_writer + snapshot_restore perms. I'll open infra ticket and reserve replica slot tentatively 03:00-05:00 UTC.
hana: Success criteria drafted: missing spans <0.05% after canary; ETL processing lag <75s steady-state; rollup diffs <0.4% after backfill. Flag issues now.
park: OK with criteria, will add integration test to assert seq monotonicity in CI.
julian: OK. Pinging @cdn-team now for header passthrough confirmation.
monica: I'll publish a short runbook + dry-run checklist by EOD+2 and post backfill playbook with verification queries.
hana: Assigning deadlines: julian header PR & CI by EOD+2, park checkpoints + seq check PR by EOD+3, monica dedupe worker PR + runbook by EOD+4. Ops/infra to confirm maintenance slot and perms. Update thread if anything slips.
ops-bot: Reminder set: 2061234567-owners-checkin scheduled 2026-03-30T09:00:00Z.
hana: Thanks all. Keep updates short in this thread; we'll reconvene after the dry-run and canary results.
